note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Cabo Verde: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident filing under the declarative method pays 16.5% on taxable income to CVE 960,000, 23.1% to 1,800,000 and 27.5% above, with net income up to CVE 220,000 a year exempt; salaried income is normally taxed by final withholding instead.

sources.said: Taxable income (CVE*) Tax rate (%) Over Not over 0 960,000 16.5 960,000 1,800,000 23.1 1,800,000 27.5
An exemption from taxation applies to net income of up to CVE 220,000 annually.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a salaried taxpayer who opts to file does so by 31 March, others by 31 May, and any balance is paid by 31 August.

sources.said: As a rule, the tax year coincides with the calendar year (i.e. 1 January to 31 December).
taxpayers must compute the tax due and file a tax return by 31 May of the following year.
Any outstanding tax liability must be paid by 31 August of the year in which the return is due.

figures.finding: Social security is 8.5% from the employee and 16% from the employer on gross pay; a self-employed person pays a fixed 19.5%.

sources.said: the contributions are due on the employee’s gross remuneration at rates of 8.5% and 16% by the employee and the employer, respectively.
The contributions applicable to self-employees corresponds to a fixed rate of 19.5%.

figures.finding: Monthly salaries are withheld at 15% to CVE 80,000 (less 5,500), 21% to 150,000 (less 10,300) and 25% above (less 16,300); business and professional income under organised accounting is withheld at 20% on account.

sources.said: Business and professional income earned by individual entrepreneurs under standard organised accounting are subject to WHT at the rate of 20% as an advance payment on account of the final annual income tax liability.
Estão sujeitos a retenção na fonte à taxa de 20% (vinte por cento), por conta do imposto devido a final, os rendimentos empresariais e profissionais relativos à prestação de serviços
The VAT system in Cabo Verde closely follows the European Union (EU) VAT system and is assessed at the standard rate of 15%.

figures.finding: A non-resident with no permanent establishment in Cabo Verde has tax withheld on Cabo Verde income at the same rates as residents, always as a final tax with no option to file: a performer's, writer's or director's fee for services, paid by a business or public body that keeps organised accounts, bears 20% of the gross fee before VAT. A non-resident is taxed only on Cabo Verde-source income at flat rates equal to residents', and cannot file a return; royalties bear 20% withholding.

value.base: gross fee for services, before VAT
value.withheldBy: payers that keep or must keep organised accounts, including public bodies and international and non-governmental organisations
value.otherwise: return and aggregation under art. 43 of the IRPS Code where no withholding rate applies
value.treaty: no withholding, or a limited one, where a double-tax convention gives Cabo Verde no or limited taxing right (art. 18)

figures.applies: Cabo Verde, from Decreto-Lei 6/2015 (23 January 2015); a later amendment of these rates was not found in the sources read.
figures.searched: Web search 2026-11-02: 'Cabo Verde Código do IRPS taxas escalões 2026 não residentes retenção na fonte taxa liberatória artistas' returned rivermate, PwC's 2026 budget flashes, occ.pt (Portugal) and the Boletim Oficial download of Decreto-Lei 6/2015 (read: this finding).

sources.said: Artigo 8.º Rendimentos da categoria B 1. Estão sujeitos a retenção na fonte à taxa de 20% (vinte por cento), por conta do imposto devido a final, os rendimentos empresariais e profissionais relativos à prestação de serviços, obtidos em território nacional, pagos ou colocados à disposição por entidades que disponham ou devam dispor de contabilidade organizada … 3. A taxa é aplicada ao rendimento ilíquido sujeito a retenção, antes da liquidação do Imposto Sobre Valor Acrescentado (IVA) a que haja lugar. … Artigo 13.º Rendimentos de não residentes 1. Os rendimentos obtidos em território nacional por não residentes, que não sejam imputáveis a estabelecimento estável nele situado, estão sujeitos a retenção na fonte, através da aplicação das taxas referidas nos artigos anteriores, que revestirão sempre caráter liberatório, sem opção de englobamento.
Non-resident individuals are subject to PIT only on Cabo Verdean-source income at flat tax rates that are the same as those applicable for resident taxpayers.
Royalty payments are subject to WHT at the rate of 20%.
